## Experience

:::: {.cv-item}
::: {.cv-item__head}
[HPC & Cloud Specialist]{.cv-item__role}[Oct 2022 – present]{.cv-item__dates}
:::
::: {.cv-item__org}
[Leibniz Supercomputing Centre (LRZ)]{.cv-item__place}[Garching bei München, DE]{.cv-item__loc}
:::

- Ran 5+ Rocky/Ubuntu VM clusters and 2 Slurm clusters on the LRZ OpenStack cloud, provisioning software stacks with Spack, EESSI and Conda for teaching and research.
- Automated deployment and configuration with Ansible, Terraform and Magic Castle.
- Operated Kubernetes (RKE/RKE2) via Rancher Fleet for CI/CD, behind Caddy and Apache2 reverse proxies with automatic SSL (ACME, Certbot).
- Built custom Jupyter IDE containers with persistent XFS/NFS storage for users.
- Added backend-agnostic GPU offloading to the Julia code GaPSE.jl with KernelAbstractions.jl.
- Lead instructor for the LRZ *Introduction to Julia* course, and supported dozens of training courses with 10 to 70 participants each.
::::

:::: {.cv-item}

:::
::: {.cv-item__org}

:::

- **Thesis:** *The Galaxy Number Counts in General Relativity: implications for Primordial Non-Gaussianities* — developed the Julia code [GaPSE.jl](https://github.com/foglienimatteo/GaPSE.jl).
- **Relevant coursework:** implemented ray-tracing software for photorealistic image generation.
- **Data analysis:** Bayesian inference and Markov-Chain Monte Carlo methods in Python with the `emcee` package.
